name: Rhumb Line
author: kolache
description: A navigator's chart table: printed sea chart by day, the same chart under the red night lamp after dark. Every conversation is a plotted course, each message a fix on the line.

credits.what: Chart backdrops, compass rose, brass instruments
Neatline frames, scales, course line and position marks
